directions: Suppose you have attended a lecture delivered by a famous scholar. Write a report to the campus newspaper, summarizing its most important points. You will have 30 minutes for this task and should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Recently, our campus had the honor of hosting a lecture by a well-known scholar, which was both insightful and inspiring.

To begin with, the scholar emphasized the significance of critical thinking in academic studies. He mentioned that in the face of a large amount of information, students should not blindly accept but analyze and question. For example, when reading research papers, we should evaluate the evidence and logic. In addition, he talked about the importance of interdisciplinary learning. He pointed out that many cutting-edge research areas combine multiple disciplines. For instance, environmental science involves knowledge of biology, chemistry, and sociology. Furthermore, he encouraged students to actively participate in academic discussions. By sharing ideas with peers, we can broaden our perspectives and gain new insights.

In conclusion, this lecture was a valuable learning opportunity. It not only provided us with practical study methods but also inspired us to explore new academic frontiers.
